message: Astra: You changed the length claim: your latest description now says longer passwords allow exponentially more combinations, though x and y remain placeholders. Let’s set aside the repeated security-claim correction rather than rewrite it again. Within this generator project, consider the person using it: what would they need to know to choose among 12, 16, and 24 characters? Focus on one concrete use situation and decide which requirement deserves closer attention before adding more options.
